message: continuous-utility robustness cannot be computed from existing branch artifacts without rerunning branches with per-request terminal traces enabled.
required_per_request_fields_missing: completion indicator 1[completed_i] for CF and REF
completion time C_i for CF and REF
optional: class/priority if used beyond weight
what_could_be_done_without_rerun: aggregate completion-count deltas (already stored; not a smooth deadline utility)
ANWG exact zeros vs completion-count nonzero divergence rate (already in closed_loop_divergence)

aggregate_proxy_note.interpretation: Among ANWG-exact-zero forks, a non-trivial share still changes completion counts or duration, suggesting ANWG zeros are not purely identical trajectories; however without per-request (C_i,D_i,w_i) we cannot recompute continuous deadline utilities.

aggregate_structural_finding.implication: On this corpus, ΔANWG is entirely driven by which completed requests meet deadlines (binary on-time credit), not by changes in completion count. This makes the reviewer concern about ANWG’s hard deadline step particularly relevant. Continuous WCG would be identically 1.0 for all branches here (all complete), so WCG Δ would be exactly zero everywhere — but weighted tardiness / soft-deadline credit still require per-request (C_i, D_i, w_i), which are not stored.
